Sonu receives a huge order of 1,000 homemade chocolate boxes for Diwali from a client named Sharma. To arrange the required ₹1.5 lakh capital, Bhide pawns Madhavi's jewelry on Dhanteras under the strict condition that he must repay the money with interest on Diwali day to get them back.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
